messages:
sam: Brightline asked for proof svc-inference did NOT have kms:Decrypt in last 90 days and chain-of-custody for logs. Fast deliverables?

liz: Minimal bundle: PR + role yaml diff, CloudTrail KMS JSON, Splunk CSV, signed manifest.

kevin: CloudTrail command I used: 
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/aa11-bb22 --start-time 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2024-03-31T23:59:59Z > kms.json
Filter for Decrypt / GenerateDataKey.

ir-oncall: I will create manifest.txt with sha256 sums and gpg --armor sign it. Then upload bundle to pre-signed S3 (7d).

sam: Any RBAC gotchas? Did role change add decrypt indirectly?

liz: Static check: role inference-worker only has kms:Encrypt. PR #5188 changed namespace binding but did not add permissions. sec-bot confirms.

kevin: Include key policy snippet (ARNs redacted) showing decrypt allowed only to ops-key-rotation and hsm-gateway.

sec-bot: Evidence bundle ready: s3://evidence-prod/brightline/4901234567-bundle.tar.gz (presigned). Manifest sha256: f1e2...9c3a.

sam: Thanks team. I'll share link and short cover note to Brightline sec. Attach reviewer names and oncall attestation.
